description:
Remove Negative Energy | Sitar Music | 1.5 Hours

Some days the air just feels heavy — like you've been carrying low, stuck, draining energy from screens, from people, from the noise of the day.

Start here. Ninety minutes of bright, uplifting sitar to clear the heaviness and raise your energy — so you feel lighter, clearer, and positive again.

What you'll hear: warm, bright sitar over a gentle pulse — open and luminous, lifting rather than soothing you down. Music that makes a room feel clearer.

Best for: clearing stuck or low energy · a fresh start to the day · resetting after a draining stretch · positive-energy rituals and a pair of headphones.

🔔 Subscribe to Raga Focus for Indian instrumental music to clear negativity, raise your energy, and feel good.
thumbnail_prompt: Pichwai/Kangra miniature painting style, ornate warm-gold patterned border. BRIGHT, LUMINOUS dawn palette — radiant gold and warm light, soft sun-rays / glow, lotus and uplifting motifs (NOT dusk/evening — this is the bright, rising-energy ship, contrast it against the evening Sarod thumb). Central figure: a serene, upright musician playing a sitar, posture open and light, a soft luminous aura/glow around them suggesting positive energy. IMPORTANT: vary the interior composition from the channel's other Sitar thumbnails so it is visually distinct in-feed (not the same painting relabeled). Overlay text 'RAISE YOUR ENERGY' in dark-teal serif, large and mobile-readable. This lane uses an OUTCOME/lifestyle overlay, NOT a question Q-hook. Mobile-first: minimal clutter, bright and inviting.
suno_prompt_A: Bright uplifting Indian classical instrumental, Raga Bhupali — pentatonic, joyful, positive and light, the feeling of heaviness lifting and a room filling with clear bright light, warm plucked sitar with meend glissando slides and gamak ornamentation, light tabla keeping a gentle positive pulse, soft tanpura drone, 528Hz tuning, 78 BPM, mid-high register, warm open airy production, seamless loop-friendly texture, like negativity dissolving and energy rising, no vocals, no humming, no human voice
suno_prompt_B: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming, bright uplifting Indian classical sitar, Raga Bhupali — pentatonic joyful positive light, warm plucked sitar with meend glides and gamak, light tabla gentle pulse, soft tanpura drone, 528Hz, 78 BPM, mid-high register, warm open airy production, seamless loop, like energy rising and the air clearing

production_spec.loop_seam: 10s in / 30s out, Suno extend 3-4x → loop in post to fill 90 min
production_spec.notes: INCLUDE light tabla (Sitar performs better with tabla per channel data — only no-tabla Sitar underperformed). 528Hz (energy/healing genre frequency) instead of the usual 432Hz — thematically apt for the energy lane + a genre SEO signal. Alpha 10Hz under at -20dB (relaxed positive presence, awake not drowsy). Bright mid-high register — this ship LIFTS, it does not soothe down. Binaural stays OUT of the Suno prompt.
